easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature that does not have flying.
description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature without flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
